ellipsoid_projections — TOMOGRAPHY ct_scan op

• 資料種類:ctgeometry → projstack

• 呼叫: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.ellipsoid_projections(geometry, ellipsoids=None, device='auto')(要直接呼叫實作,import ctscan; ctscan.ellipsoid_projections(geometry, ellipsoids=None, device='auto');從台帳取用則 opstomography.get("ellipsoid_projections"))

• GPU:無(僅 CPU 參考實作)

用法

橢球之和的精確線積分，適用於本族的任意掃描。

> 以下的詳細說明為原文 —— 摘要與標題已翻譯。

Each ray is mapped to the frame where the ellipsoid is a unit sphere, and the chord length comes from the quadratic's discriminant. No voxels, no interpolation and no projector are involved, which is what makes this the ground truth the projector and every reconstruction here are measured against.

:param geometry: dict from ct_scan_geometry. :param ellipsoids: (N, 8) rows; None gives SHEPP_LOGAN_3D. :param device: "auto", "cpu" or "cuda". :returns: (view, V, U) float array. :raises ValueError: on a geometry not from ct_scan_geometry.
